instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Under a covered outdoor pavilion with white metal trusses and blue pillars, two young men are sparring. On the left, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) faces right, holding both gloves tightly in front of his face in a high guard. On the right, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands with his back to the camera, throwing a punch with his left glove. The boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) throws a punch at the boxer in the blue tank top (R2), who blocks with his high guard. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight with soft shadows.
elements: R1 throws a left-glove punch at R2
R2 blocks R1's punch with a high guard
